name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9: Hoenn to Paldea)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Expands the playable Pokédex to #1025 with 419 Gen 3-9 families, 72 custom attacks, and 24 signature Ultimates.
description: Complete Gen 3 through Gen 9 character and moveset expansion covering Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea (#252-#1025). Adds 419 playable base evolution families, 774 species with animated sprites, 72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types, and 24 custom signature Ultimates for iconic starters, pseudos, and legendaries. Pure Pokémon and attacks pack with zero bundled levels; pair with Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack for regional maps.
highlights: Expands the Pokédex cap from #251 to #1025 across all 7 Gen 3-9 regions
419 playable base families (all starters, fan favorites, Paradox Pokémon, and legendaries)
72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types rendered via PokéBonk's native GPU VFX engine
24 custom Ultimates (Rayquaza, Lucario, Garchomp, Greninja, Zacian, Koraidon, Miraidon, Raging Bolt, Terapagos, and more)
Characters start locked by default for progression, with per-generation unlock tools in Unbound Settings
